## Checklist

Every box below was bought by a real failure on 29 August 2026. Tick it only if you
checked it on **this** PR — not if it is usually true.

- [ ] **Gates green on THIS SHA — the CEO pulled it, not assumed.**
      A branch that was green before a rebase, a force-push, or one more commit is
      not this SHA. `gh run list --json headSha,conclusion` and read the SHA.
- [ ] **No `.sql` without its pin.**
      A branch that adds or removes a migration file moves the money-grain tree
      digest and must carry the new pin in the same PR. Measure it with the
      gitignored credential migration moved aside, or you will pin the local number
      and go red on the first CI run. Verify with `node tools/checks/migration-pin-travels.mjs`.
- [ ] **No `grant … to anon`.**
      RULE E6. Grant to `authenticated`. Three of these reached a reviewed PR on
      29 Aug. Check the diff, not your memory of writing it.
- [ ] **Each migration file matches `schema_migrations.statements` for its version.**
      Filing a draft under a stamped version makes the repository assert that
      production ran something it never ran. Compare the sha256 of the file
      (CRLF normalised) against the stored statements. If they differ, the file is
      wrong — do not adjust the version to suit the file.
- [ ] **Ingest is not in this PR.**
      No `stg_*` tables, no file from `ingest/*`, nothing generated by
      `tools/ingest/`. If GitHub offered you a Compare banner for an ingest branch,
      you are on the wrong branch.
